_comment: Air Corridors (UX redesign v2): curated tactical lanes per map+era. Selecting one orients the mission's THREAT AXIS down the lane and concentrates enemy air defenses + CAP toward its far (enemy) end. Geometry is a compass BEARING (degrees, from the friendly side toward the enemy) + REACH (metres to the enemy focus), so it is map-agnostic and needs no per-corridor lat/lon. 'axis'/'enemy' are briefing text. NO player waypoints are placed — this shapes the ENEMY picture and the threat axis only.
